before-psa.label: before-psa
limitations: CPU timings only; headless does not measure GPU rendering or visible FPS
Godot memory/resource counters are retained-state measurements, not a transient allocation or file-I/O trace
Sampling probe is excluded from update timings but included in callback intervals
Fixed workload isolates animation and excludes arena, tactical AI and ball simulation
